company_definition: HyperVision develops patented ultra-wide-field-of-view optical visual engines and HMD architecture that preserve focused detail while restoring peripheral visual context.
offers: advanced simulation RDK, HMD and visual engines
partner-enabled digital day/night vision HMD integration
paid feasibility, NRE, pilot integration, product sales, support and licensing

human_perception_need.anchors: 0 none; 1 adjacent possibility; 2 supported downstream operator use; 3 direct target-company workflow; 4 quantified mission-critical target-company pain

integration_fit.anchors: 0 none; 1 conceptual; 2 concrete complementary interfaces; 3 strong supported component and responsibility fit

commercial_capacity.anchors: 0 no evidence; 1 funding/revenue/commercialization evidence; 2 established budget, major program or demonstrated procurement capacity

timing_and_access.anchors: 0 no verified current route; 1 explicit current relationship, warm access, active joint work, procurement or named opportunity

geography_policy.exclude_when: The company is currently incorporated or headquartered in Russia, controlled by a Russian parent, or materially operates as a Russian company.
geography_policy.founder_birthplace_rule: A founder being born, educated or formerly employed in Russia is not a penalty when the company is genuinely based and controlled elsewhere.
geography_policy.unknown_rule: Unknown geography receives no bonus or penalty. Never infer origin from a name, language or appearance.

evidence_rules: Use only verified facts supplied to the assessment.
Every material conclusion must cite one or more verified fact IDs.
A customer hypothesis requires evidence of a human-operator visual-perception need.

Customer means the target company itself plausibly buys, integrates or operates the HyperVision visual interface. A downstream use case of the target company's product does not by itself prove that the target is a customer.

A technology-partner hypothesis does not require the company itself to buy an HMD. It may qualify by supplying a complementary component required by a supported joint architecture, such as panoramic or EO/IR imaging, embedded electronics, HMD productization, simulation integration, manufacturing, communications, or a remote platform.
Investor means an organization that deploys capital into other companies. Evidence that the target raised money does not make it an investor.
Sector similarity and funding alone do not prove customer or partner fit.
Return insufficient_evidence instead of inventing a score, relationship or origin.
Keep customer, partner and investor hypotheses separate.
First engagement must be a proposed action by HyperVision, not a description of the target company's existing activity.
Do not treat missing public information as evidence that a capability, budget, need or opportunity is absent.
Report an evidence-backed confirmed score separately from a potential score. The potential score is conditional and must name the unknown facts that would have to be verified.
Provide concrete verification questions and distinguish qualified, promising_needs_verification, research_needed, low_fit and excluded companies.
